study type: Retrospective cohort for model development and internal validation
outcome: Heart failure/arrest during surgery or procedure
cohort: The study included 4171 participants with preeclampsia at delivery from 2007 to 2017 at an academic obstetrics hospital.
finding: The study developed and internally validated an 8-variable risk prediction model that identified women with preeclampsia at highest risk of acute cardiovascular morbidity with good discrimination (AUC 0.72) and calibration.
mod_finding: Previous caesarean delivery was positively associated with acute cardiovascular morbidity (OR 1.47 [1.01-2.13]).
